message: 人類の剣

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Meow!」
At the signal from the voice of a demon who seemed to be their captain, the demons called off the fight and retreated while shielding their injured comrades.

name: Ria
message: 「Did we win...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, don't run away!」

name: Synn
message: 「There's no point pushing ourselves. We don't have the energy left to chase them anyway.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, you saw right through me?」

name: Sally
message: 「Damn it. For mere small fry, they sure had the nerve to pull off coordinated attacks--made them a huge pain to fight.」
It really had been a tough fight.
We had the upper hand, sure, but we couldn't completely overwhelm them.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, something feels different from before. How should I put it... Doesn't it feel like water is receding right now?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, I feel it too. Like the restless atmosphere is thinning out or something...」

name: Ria
message: 「What is this sensation?」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh. You guys can actually tell, even though you're human, Prez.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Magic power is receding from this whole area.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Since the demons broke off the battle and are retreating, the surge of magical presence from the fighting is fading away.」

name: Sally
message: 「Bingo.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if Azel is okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, you didn't run away?!」

name: Azel
message: 「I am an officer of the Student Council.」
She might not have a Rosary, but Azel is still one of our comrades, after all.

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, do we happen to have any spare Rosaries?」

name: Ria
message: 「Unfortunately, we don't.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... As expected of Synn-sama. Having grown tired of the naked bodies of the women nearby, you're already looking to legally see a new woman naked.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn! Is that what you're implying!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Definitely not!」

name: Synn
message: 「It wasn't me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not me either, so that means.」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It wasn't me!」

name: Azel
message: 「What is this sound.」

name: Sally
message: 「Aye-aye, Sally-chan's here to explain it all! When you get suuuper hungry, your tummy growls!」

name: Azel
message: 「How strange.」

name: Sally
message: 「It's your stomach, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that so?」
I see, Azel's hungry, huh...

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, wanna go grab something to eat together now?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm in! So, where are we going?」

name: Sally
message: 「Me too! Beef bowls, beef bowls!」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm in too, though I wonder if Sally-chan ever eats anything besides beef bowls?」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll eat anything if you give it to me~」

name: Ria
message: 「Is that right.\s02」

name: Azel
message: 「I refuse.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's my treat.」

name: Azel
message: 「Understood.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn!? Dining and dashing is bad!」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't you think jumping to that conclusion is a bit much?」

name: Azel
message: 「What is dining and dashing?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's eating at a restaurant without paying.」

name: Azel
message: 「It is an efficient, rational course of action.」

name: Synn
message: 「You can't do that.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why?」

name: Ria
message: 「Because it's a bad thing to do.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is it a crime.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not just a crime, a huge crime, ya hear. Dining and dashing is super uncool.」

name: Azel
message: 「If it is a crime, I will not do it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, dig in, dig in!」

name: Azel
message: 「Quiet. How could I eat something so greasy and utterly vulgar!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's delicious. Big sis guarantees it.」

name: Azel
message: 「I have no need for guarantees. Food only needs to provide nutrition.」

name: Sally
message: 「If you don't eat it, Azel, I won't feel safe eating it either.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What is she, a poison taster.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... you don't know how to use chopsticks, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「What did you say!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come to think of it, you're always eating things like Vandine Jelly that don't require chopsticks.」
Nice one, Nanaka. She caught onto my plan and joined in on the taunting.

name: Azel
message: 「How insolent! Of course I can use such a simple tool.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, but I've never actually seen you use them.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right. Anyone can talk a big game.」

name: Sally
message: 「Not knowing how to use chopsticks is super lame, Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you doubting my word!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not that we doubt you, just don't push yourself, okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「A whole week of trai--no, never mind. Regardless, I can use them!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll swap it out for something you can eat with your hands.」

name: Azel
message: 「Hold it!」

name: Azel
message: 「All I have to do is show you I can use chopsticks, right!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look at her pushing herself.」

name: Azel
message: 「I am not pushing myself! Just watch!」
Nanaka and I exchanged a glance. It worked.

name: Azel
message: 「Just watch!」
Azel picked up the chopsticks, and

name: Azel
message: 「How's that! I can use them, can't I!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you actually have to eat with them before we can say anything.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why must I eat something so pointlessly packed with calories, with grease floating on top like poison...」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have to force yourself. You can still get by in life even if you can't use chopsticks.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's a little embarrassing, though.」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up, shut up, shut up! All I have to do is eat it, right!」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm digging in too!」

name: Azel
message: 「Wh-What is this?!」

name: Sally
message: 「What the--this is delicious?!」

name: Azel
message: 「What is this food?!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's ramen.」
It cost me my entire fortune, though I mustn't say that.

name: Azel
message: 「Ramen?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bean sprout ramen, to be exact. The broth, made with Five-Star Restaurant's prized secret dashi, has a truly bewitching flavor!」

name: Kim-san
message: 「Missy, I'd appreciate it if you didn't say that tagline out loud, aru. It's embarrassing, aru.」

name: Azel
message: 「A demon general?! Is this connected to the demons?!」

name: Sally
message: 「'Demon General flavor' means... could Boss be an ingredient!? E-Eek! Sorry, Boss, it's so good!」

name: Ria
message: 「Not like that, um... it means the flavor is so enchanting that once you eat it, you get hooked.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I see... Then there is no issue.」
Saying that, Azel digs in enthusiastically, chomping away.

name: Nanaka
message: 「It really is addictive.」

name: Ria
message: 「It's my first time eating here, and it's delicious.」

name: Azel
message: 「There is no way I would become addicted. It is mere sustenance... nom, nom, illogical, nom, nom, impossible. Purely nutritional intake, yet, nom, this is, how, slurrrrrp.」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't know what ramen was, Azel?」
Slurp--Azel raises her head with noodles still dangling from her mouth.

name: Azel
message: 「Of course I know. It is ramen!」
Yeah, she definitely didn't know.

name: Azel
message: 「Why are you the only one not eating?」

name: Synn
message: 「I just really like water.」
I'm not crying, right? I'm doing great, totally great.

name: Azel
message: 「Is that so.」
As if that could possibly be true.
Ah, what a cruel aroma...

name: Nanaka
message: 「You okay, Synn? It'll be here soon.」

name: Synn
message: 「Soon?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-Nothing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious! Water sure is delicious! Another glass, please.」

name: Kim-san
message: 「Coming right up. And here's bean sprout ramen too, ya know.」
In front of me sits a glass of ice water and, for some reason, bean sprout ramen!

name: Synn
message: 「Um... I didn't order anything--」

name: Kim-san
message: 「Call it friendship, ya know.」
Following Kim-san's gaze, I see a bashful-looking Nanaka and a smiling Senior Ria.
Thank you, Nanaka! Thank you, Senior Ria!

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for the food! Whoa. So good! So good, so good!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You really think anything's good, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「So good! The best, so good!」

name: Sally
message: 「Man, I gotta tell Boss about this too! It's delicious!」

name: Azel
message: 「I see... Could this be what 'delicious' means...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. That's what tasty--what delicious means.」

name: Azel
message: 「Ah, I am experiencing deliciousness right now!」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh-huh, it's tasty, and it's delicious.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn's crying...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now you've got me tearing up too...」

name: Azel
message: 「Ah, there is so little left already. Slurp, slurp. No, it is only natural for food to disappear when eaten. It is rational.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yet what is this sense of loss!? For mere nutrient intake, this is... My emotions are being needlessly stirred... What is this...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-Is it really that big a deal...?」

name: Sally
message: 「Kwah, delicious! Way too delicious! The Human World is awesome!」

name: Azel
message: 「Could it be... that this liquid is also drinkable... Even this dubious liquid with oil floating on it...」

name: Azel
message: 「Yet this aroma! Urgh, I want to drink it... I want to gulp it right down... What a wild, irrational impulse.」

name: Ria
message: 「It's totally fine to drink it.\s02」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I know that. It is ramen, after all.」
Gripping the rim of the bowl tightly, Azel drank it all down in one hearty gulp.

name: Azel
message: 「Gulp... glug... glug... glug...」
I caught up to her and gulped mine down too.

name: Azel
message: 「Phew...」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew...」
It was at the exact same time.
In no time, our bowls were empty. Not a single drop of broth remained.
When we set our bowls down, our eyes met.

name: Azel
message: 「It's delicious.」
She was smiling.
She's cute, I thought.
